name: Statistical Learning
description:
- Statistical learning theory: loss functions, generalisation, empirical risk minimisation, bias-variance trade-off, Bayes classifier and Bayes risk
- k-Nearest Neighbors
- Decision trees and ensemble methods: bagging, boosting, random forests
- Linear regression, basis functions, ridge regression
- Optimization: convexity, gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, adaptive methods
- Logistic regression: maximum likelihood, maximum a posteriori, multiclass extension
- Deep neural networks: backpropagation, regularisation, calibration, double descent
- Generative vs. discriminative classification: linear and quadratic discriminant analysis
- Mixture models, EM algorithm, clustering
- Dimensionality reduction: PCA, SVD, probabilistic PCA
- Variational inference and variational autoencoders
- Diffusion models and flow matching
prerequisites:
- Linear algebra
- Multivariate calculus
- Probability theory and statistics
- Python programming
